# Avatar Maker

Avatar maker: profile picture avatars (PFP) generated from a description in 3D cartoon, anime, flat, comic or pixel styles.

## What it does
Describe the person or character and pick a style. Claude tells you the price and creates up to four options.

**How the files are made:** each avatar is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Made from a description, not from your photo.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install avatar-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Avatar Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/avatar/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each avatar uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The avatars show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_avatar_models` | Models for avatars with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_avatar_cost` | Exact price of one avatar before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_avatar` | Starts one avatar in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_avatar` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A 3D cartoon avatar of a woman with curly red hair and glasses"
- "An anime avatar of a gamer with headphones"
- "A pixel art avatar of a bearded hiker"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the avatar (the description and the style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
- Support: https://megascenes.com/support
